+import sys
+from line_profiler.explicit_profiler import _FALSY_STRINGS

+import sys
+print("Initial sys.argv:", sys.argv)
+
+# Import the profile object and check its state
+from line_profiler.explicit_profiler import profile
+
+print("Before decorating function:")
+print("  profile.enabled:", profile.enabled)
+print("  profile._profile:", profile._profile)
+
+# Create a simple script that uses the @profile decorator
+@profile
+def test_function():
+    print("Inside test_function")
+    return 42
+
+print("After decorating function:")
+print("  profile.enabled:", profile.enabled)
+print("  profile._profile:", profile._profile)
+
+# Run without any explicit profiling configuration
+print("Calling test_function...")
+result = test_function()
+print("Result:", result)
+
+print("Final state:")
+print("  profile.enabled:", profile.enabled)
+print("  profile._profile:", profile._profile)
